info.name: 48Date - WebSocket & Real-Time Gateway
info.description:
# 48Date WebSocket & Real-Time Gateway Collection

Dedicated collection containing **all real-time Socket.IO events, client actions, server broadcasts, and message payload variants** for 48Date (Chat Module 05, Games Module 06, Dates Module 07).

### Connection Configuration
- **Base Socket URL:** `{{socketUrl}}` (Default: `http://localhost:3000`)
- **Protocol:** Socket.IO v4 (Engine.IO v4)
- **Authentication:** Bearer Access Token passed via:
  - Handshake query parameter: `?token={{accessToken}}`
  - OR Handshake header: `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`
- **Transports:** `['websocket', 'polling']`

### Collection Structure
1. **00 - Connection & Handshake:** Initial handshake, auth verification, and client setup.
2. **01 - Client Actions (Emit Events):** Events sent by the Flutter client (`joinConversation`, `typing`, `message:seen`, etc.) with success and error responses.
3. **02 - Server Broadcasts: message:new:** All 9 rich payload variants (`TEXT`, `IMAGE`, `VOICE`, `GAME` invitation/result, `DATE` requested/accepted/cancelled, `SYSTEM`).
4. **03 - Server Broadcasts: Status & Receipts:** Live delivery receipts, seen receipts, typing indicators, and room closures.

item.description: Initial HTTP handshake and connection verification endpoints.

header.description: Bearer access token for handshake authentication (alternative to ?token query parameter).

JWT bearer access token for socket authentication.

request.description:
Executes the initial Engine.IO handshake to establish a socket session.

**Query params:**
- `EIO` (string, required): Engine.IO protocol version (`4`).
- `transport` (string, required): Initial transport (`polling`).
- `token` (string, optional): Bearer token if not sent in Authorization header.

Informs server that messages up to `upToSeq` have reached the device.

**Body fields:**

- `upToSeq` (integer, required): Monotonic sequence number.

Updates `seen_up_to_seq` and `delivered_up_to_seq` and notifies partner.

**Body fields:**
- `conversationId` (string, required, UUID): Conversation ID.
- `upToSeq` (integer, required): Monotonic sequence number.

item.name: 03 - Server Broadcasts: Status & Receipts
item.description: Read receipts, delivered status updates, typing indicators, and room closure broadcasts.

request.description:
Emitted to the sender when the recipient's device receives messages.
`deliveredUpToSeq` indicates messages delivered (double grey checks in UI).

Emitted to the sender when the recipient opens and reads messages.
`seenUpToSeq` indicates messages seen (double blue checks in UI).
Relayed to the client when the other user is typing.
Relayed to the client when the other user stops typing.

Emitted when 48 hours elapse without an accepted date plan.
Flutter locks the message input and shows match expired overlay.

Emitted when either user blocks the other.
Flutter removes the active room and marks conversation closed.

Emitted in real-time when either player submits an answer for a question in This or That.

- If partner has NOT answered yet: partnerRevealed is false and partnerChoice is omitted (No Peeking Rule D-113).
- Once BOTH have answered: partnerRevealed is true, partnerChoice is revealed, and isMatch indicates if both choices agreed.
Emitted in real-time to both players when the 10th and final question is answered by both users.

Emitted to both participants (their `user:{id}` rooms and the `conversation:{id}` room) when a `SET` date is marked `COMPLETED`, which happens automatically one day after its scheduled time. Update the date bubble/card to `COMPLETED` and open the rating flow (`POST /dates/{id}/rating`). Both users also receive a `DATE_RATE_REQUEST` notification.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the completed date.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match it belongs to.
- `conversationId` (UUID): the conversation whose date bubble changed.
- `status` (string): always `COMPLETED`.
- `completedAt` (ISO 8601 UTC): when it was marked completed.

Emitted to the conversation room when a new date invitation is proposed. Displays the interactive venue card in chat with Accept and Decline actions for the recipient.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the date plan ID.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match it belongs to.
- `conversationId` (UUID): conversation receiving the date invitation.
- `status` (string): `REQUESTED`.
- `datePlan` (object): the complete date plan object.

Emitted when the recipient accepts a date invitation. Permanently stops the 48-hour expiration timer for both participants.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the accepted date plan.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match.
- `conversationId` (UUID): the conversation.
- `status` (string): `SET`.
- `clockStopped` (boolean): `true`.
- `datePlan` (object): the updated date plan.

Emitted when the recipient declines a proposed date invitation. Updates the chat bubble state to declined.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the declined date plan.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match.
- `conversationId` (UUID): the conversation.
- `status` (string): `CANCELLED`.
- `declinedBy` (UUID): user ID who declined.
- `datePlan` (object): date plan snapshot.

Emitted when the date proposer withdraws their pending invitation before a response is made.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the withdrawn date plan.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match.
- `conversationId` (UUID): the conversation.
- `status` (string): `CANCELLED`.
- `withdrawnBy` (UUID): proposer user ID.

Emitted when a previously confirmed (SET) date plan is cancelled by either partner with a reason.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the cancelled date plan.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match.
- `conversationId` (UUID): the conversation.
- `status` (string): `CANCELLED`.
- `cancelledBy` (UUID): user ID who cancelled.
- `reason` (string): cancellation explanation text.

Emitted when one partner requests to reschedule/postpone an existing date to a new time.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the date plan.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match.
- `conversationId` (UUID): the conversation.
- `requestId` (UUID): the postpone request identifier.
- `requestedBy` (UUID): user who requested postpone.
- `oldScheduledAt` (ISO 8601 UTC): original time.
- `newScheduledAt` (ISO 8601 UTC): proposed new time.

Emitted when the partner accepts or declines a date postpone request.

**Payload fields:**
- `datePlanId` (UUID): the date plan.
- `matchId` (UUID): the match.
- `conversationId` (UUID): the conversation.
- `requestId` (UUID): the postpone request.
- `action` (string): `ACCEPT` or `DECLINE`.
- `respondedBy` (UUID): partner ID.
- `newScheduledAt` (ISO 8601 UTC): final scheduled time if accepted.

item.name: 17 date:awaiting_confirmation • Scheduled Date Passed & Attendance Confirmation Required

request.description:
Emitted to the conversation room and both participants when a `SET` date's scheduled calendar time has passed.

Prompts both users to open the `M / ATTENDANCE` screen and confirm whether they met.
Emitted to the conversation room when one participant confirms date attendance while waiting for their partner's response (`M / ATTENDANCE-WAIT`).

item.name: 19 message:edited — Message Edited in Conversation Room

request.description:
Emitted by server to `conversation:{id}` and both participants' `user:{id}` rooms whenever a message is edited (DF-13, D-207).

### Payload Shape
```json
{
  "messageId": "uuid",
  "conversationId": "uuid",
  "text": "new text",
  "isEdited": true,
  "editedAt": "2026-10-30T21:00:00.000Z"
}
```

item.name: 20 message:deleted — Message Soft-Deleted in Conversation Room

request.description:
Emitted by server to `conversation:{id}` and both participants' `user:{id}` rooms whenever a message is soft-deleted (DF-13, D-207).

### Payload Shape
```json
{
  "messageId": "uuid",
  "conversationId": "uuid",
  "isDeleted": true,
  "deletedAt": "2026-10-30T21:05:00.000Z"
}
```
